_readme: Manually maintained unlisted-equity data. Arthdex cannot fetch this automatically: no exchange publishes unlisted prices, and UnlistedZone's Terms of Use prohibit automated access and systematic data extraction. Replace these records with figures from a source you are entitled to use, and set `source` and `lastUpdated` honestly. Both are rendered in the UI, and any record still marked illustrative shows a warning banner.

pixel-vision.name: Pixel Vision Technologies

governanceFlags.title: Emphasis of matter on revenue recognition
governanceFlags.detail: Statutory auditor flagged percentage-of-completion estimates on two long-gestation defence contracts. No qualification issued; management has since disclosed the underlying cost-to-complete assumptions.
governanceFlags.source: FY26 Annual Report, Independent Auditor's Report

governanceFlags.title: Related-party lease with promoter entity
governanceFlags.detail: Manufacturing facility at Pune leased from a promoter-controlled entity at ₹2.4 Cr per annum. Independent valuation obtained; terms within arm's-length range.

governanceFlags.title: All statutory filings current
governanceFlags.detail: No pending ROC filings. GST and provident-fund remittances current as at 30 June 2026.

milestones.detail: Hire brings listed-company reporting experience, commonly read as pre-IPO preparation.

droneacharya.name: Droneacharya Aerial Innovations

governanceFlags.title: Commercial dispute with a state survey agency
governanceFlags.detail: ₹38 Cr claim contested over alleged non-performance on a photogrammetry mandate. Matter is at the arbitration stage; an adverse award would absorb roughly 9% of the current order book.

governanceFlags.detail: Auditor qualified the FY26 opinion over ₹24 Cr of receivables outstanding beyond 365 days, against which no provision has been recognised.
governanceFlags.source: FY26 Annual Report, Independent Auditor's Report

governanceFlags.title: Delayed ROC annual return filing
governanceFlags.detail: AOC-4 for FY26 filed 41 days past the statutory due date with additional fees paid.

governanceFlags.title: Promoter advance repaid in full
governanceFlags.detail: ₹6.2 Cr unsecured advance outstanding at FY25 close was repaid during FY26.
